themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe continue to advocate for policies that prioritize nationals over immigrants in accessing public aid, housing, and social services. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, and now prominently in regional coalitions in Spain's Castilla y León and other regions.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Rejected by PP in Balearic Parliament but included in Castilla y León coalition deal with PP, emphasizing residency and contribution criteria for public aid and housing.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government adopts similar rhetoric, emphasizing Italy's leadership in EU migration policies and prioritizing nationals in social aid.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 PP
countries.note: Accepted Vox's 'national priority' in Castilla y León coalition, marking a shift from previous opposition.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Continues to advocate for policies favoring French nationals in public services and housing.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes policies to prioritize Norwegian citizens in housing and social services.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant gains in local and regional elections across Europe, particularly in Germany, Italy, and Spain. These gains are reshaping political landscapes and influencing coalition formations.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, with realistic prospects of forming state governments.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Strengthens its position in local governments, often forming coalitions with other right-wing parties.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Gains influence in regional governments through coalitions with PP, securing key portfolios in Castilla y León and other regions.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Maintains strong polling numbers and influence in Swedish local governments.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right parties and leaders are reacting to ongoing conflicts in the Middle East, often aligning with hardline stances on Israel and criticizing Iran. These reactions are shaping foreign policy narratives in the US, Argentina, Italy, Poland, and France.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Criticizes Iran and supports Israel, aligning with US and EU policies.
